description: Draft a day-by-day business trip itinerary in Japan for an industry and travel month: relevant trade shows (found with web search), business visits, leisure, a rough budget in JPY, and official institutions verified by JpBiz when they match. Takes 30-60 seconds. The result is an AI draft: tell the user to confirm trade show dates on the official sites. Afterwards hotel_search_link and flight_search_link can turn the trip dates into search links.

departure.description: Departure city, e.g. 'Shanghai'. Used for the flight budget. If omitted, flights are not estimated and the budget total excludes them.

industry.description: The traveller's industry, free text, e.g. 'semiconductors', '汽车零部件', '食品加工'.

language.description: Language of the reply (and of the partner page for links): zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English, ja = Japanese. Use the user's language.

month.description: Travel month, YYYY-MM, from the current month up to 12 months ahead.

preferences.description: Anything else: cities, companies or facilities to visit, number of travellers, dinner budget, dietary needs.

name: generate_itinerary
title: Draft a Japan business trip itinerary
